asA: test-author starting a new round, and the stage-keeper judging the branch
iWant: rcf audit separation to refuse any stage regression except a new round right after a failed verdict
soThat: every fix round re-runs all five stages and no BUILD or DEFINE commit slips in after a passed review
description: The round state machine inside rcf audit separation.
title: The test-author and the stage-keeper see round order judged in the audit, with a failed verdict as the only road back to DEFINE

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given a fixture branch DEFINE:, BUILD:, REVIEW: (a passed review.json for its parent H), TEST: (a PASS test.json for H) and FINALISE: (rcf/fbs/ only), when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 0 with "separation: PASS 5 commits (base <b7>, head <h7>): DEFINE 1, BUILD 1, REVIEW 1, TEST 1, FINALISE 1, merges 0, transition 0".

[happy] Given a fixture branch DEFINE:, BUILD:, REVIEW: (code FINDINGS), DEFINE: (the test-author's triage), BUILD:, REVIEW: (MERGE/PASS), TEST: (PASS), when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 0: the regression to DEFINE: right after the failed verdict starts round two.

[failure] Given a fixture branch DEFINE:, BUILD:, REVIEW: (MERGE/PASS), BUILD: (a further code change), when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 4 with the item "<s7> BUILD: after REVIEW: without a failed verdict (stage order is monotonic within a round)"; the same holds for a DEFINE: after a passed REVIEW: or after a TEST: PASS, and for a DEFINE: after BUILD: with no verdict between.

[failure] Given a fixture branch whose REVIEW: commit records FINDINGS and whose next commit is "BUILD: quick fix", when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 4 with the item "<s7> BUILD: after a failed verdict; the next round starts at DEFINE:"; the same holds for a TEST: right after a TEST: FAIL.

[failure] Given a REVIEW: commit whose review.json head is not its parent, and a TEST: commit whose test.json head is not the round's reviewed head, when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 4 with "<s7> REVIEW: verdict head <x7> is not its parent <p7>" and "<s7> TEST: verdict head <x7> is not the reviewed head <H7>".

[edge] Given a fixture branch REVIEW: (MERGE/PASS), TEST: (PASS), FINALISE: (a clean merge of main), FINALISE: (rcf/fbs/ only), when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 0; given the same branch with a further "DEFINE: amend" or "TEST: rerun" after the FINALISE: commits, it exits 4 with "<s7> DEFINE: after FINALISE: without a failed verdict (stage order is monotonic within a round)" or the same item for TEST:.

[must-not] No commit message text changes a round verdict: a REVIEW: commit whose subject says MERGE but whose review.json records FINDINGS closes the round; a REVIEW: commit with no review.json is judged on classes and counts as no verdict, so it never opens TEST; and the audit never reads a verdict from anywhere but the file the commit adds.

[non-functional] Given a fixture range of 6 rounds (30 or more commits, each REVIEW: and TEST: adding a verdict file), when rcf audit separation runs, then the round judgement adds no more than one git process per verdict commit to the budget of the per-commit judgement and the run finishes within 5 seconds on a CI-class runner.
